data.comment:
## Architecture recheck (2026-09-29) — one-line fix was insufficient

The plan (2026-09-26) assumed all eight games were tracked in-tree under
`example-games/<game>/`. That is no longer true on current `dev`: the
multi-repo migration (CG-0MUTR7DLMY008CK17 / Option A) landed and the core repo
now carries **no games at HEAD except the Gym** (`example-games/gym` only, no
`.gitmodules`). The discovery plugin resolves every game **only** as a sibling
checkout `../tce-<game>` (it no longer falls back to in-tree copies).

Consequence: setting `GAMES_CONFIG=full` alone would make the Pages build
**fail outright** — in GitHub Actions only the core repo is checked out, so
`[tce-game-discovery] Game "beleaguered-castle" not found` aborts the build
instead of shipping all games. The original one-line change would have broken
`deploy.yml` on `main`.

## Revised implementation

Mirrored the established CI pattern from `package.yml`
(CG-0MULGC6VP008GPH2, "CI Windows binary ships no games"): a
**Compose sibling game repositories** step clones each `configs/full.json`
`path` (`../tce-<game>`) from `https://github.com/TheWizardsCode/tce-<game>.git`
before the Build step, and the Build step pins `GAMES_CONFIG=full`. The
workflow `deploy.yml` now has both; the regression test pins both (and the
ordering).

## Verification (worktree)

- `GAMES_CONFIG=full npm run build` exits 0 in the worktree **with the eight
  sibling repos composed** → 532 modules, `dist/` bundle contains all nine
  catalogue ids (8 games + Gym).
- `npm run build` (core-only default) exits 0.
- `tests/scripts/deploy-workflow.test.ts` — 4 tests green: pins exactly one
  Build step, `GAMES_CONFIG=full` on it, a sibling-composition step that
  references `configs/full.json` + `TheWizardsCode` and precedes Build, and no
  `GAMES_CONFIG=all`.
- `deploy.yml` parses as valid YAML; step order is Checkout → Setup Node →
  Install dependencies → Compose sibling game repositories → Build → Configure
  Pages → Upload artifact → Deploy.

Scope note: composing siblings is the minimal change required to satisfy
AC2/AC3 in the real deploy environment; without it the preset pin cannot work.
No `configs/all.json` alias was created (canonical preset remains `full`).
